display.title: Words Are Like Arrows: Shemiras Halashon, Part 1
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi introduces the Chofetz Chaim and his lesson of guarding our tongue: words, like an arrow already shot, can never be called back.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi introduces the great Chofetz Chaim, famous for teaching shemiras halashon, guarding one's tongue, and named after his best-known sefer. Our Sages teach that a person's very life depends on the tongue: words can bring blessing and good fortune, or great harm. Following the Baal Shem Tov's teaching that we learn how to serve Hashem from everything we see or hear, Uncle Yossi explains the bow and arrow: as long as the arrow is still on the string, the archer controls when and where it goes, but once it is released nothing can stop it. Our words are the same; before we speak we can choose them and our tone, but afterwards it is too late. That is why Hashem placed the tongue behind 32 teeth and two lips. The clip ends where the story introduced here begins.
display.lesson: Think before you speak: once words leave your mouth, you cannot take them back.
